subject: Inference Summit follow-up: GreenLytics inference needs & next step
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophie Carter <sophie@greenlytics.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@greenlytics.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Inference Summit follow-up: GreenLytics inference needs & next step

Hi Sophie — great to meet you at the Inference Summit yesterday. Quick recap from our hallway chat so we’re aligned and can pick a concrete next step: 

- You mentioned a POC requirement around real-time product recommendations (seq length ~128) and a 100–200 qps burst pattern, with a target 95th p95 latency under 80ms.
- Primary concerns: predictable latency, cost per 1k tokens, and SOC 2 / data residency for EU customers (GreenLytics has a few EU tenants).

Suggested next steps:
1) 30-minute discovery call to map traffic shape, model ops constraints, and success criteria.
2) Share a simple cost + latency sketch and SOC 2 summary for procurement.

I attached a short Redwood brief that explains our Dedicated vs Hosted profiles and an initial pricing grid (stub). Can you share who on your side owns procurement / security and if Q2 is still your expected decision window?

Thanks — I can do Tue/Wed next week afternoon PT.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com

Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 09:18:00 -0700

Thanks, Karthik — really helpful recap.

We're definitely interested. A couple quick asks before we set a working session:
- Can you send a high-level pricing grid (on-demand vs reserved) and expected throughput per GPU for a 7B/13B class model?
- Do you have a SOC 2 summary we can share with our security team?

Timeline: still Q2 but procurement will only sign off if we can show a plan for <100ms p95 for our typical traffic.

Cc'ing Tom (engineering) so he can weigh in on the qps and model class.

Best,
Sophie Carter
Director of Product, GreenLytics
Sophie.Carter@greenlytics.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Wed, 04 Mar 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Inference Summit follow-up: GreenLytics inference needs & next step

On Tue, Mar 3, 2026 at 9:18 AM Sophie Carter <sophie@greenlytics.com> wrote:
> Thanks, Karthik — really helpful recap.

Thanks Sophie — attached a concise pricing-grid.xlsx (stub) and our SOC2-summary.pdf (one-page snapshot). Quick notes to orient Tom:
- Typical throughput: a single A100-class Dedicated worker (mixed batch) will handle ~150–220 qps for 7B in low-latency mode; for 13B expect 60–100 qps depending on quantization and prefix reuse.
- Cost sketch: on-demand is higher per-token; reserved buys down ~30%–45% depending on commit.
- For p95 <100ms we usually recommend: 1) Dedicated capacity or low-latency hosted tier, 2) prefix/KV caching for repeated contexts, 3) a short canary for production traffic to validate latency SLOs.

Propose a 30-min discovery on Thu 3/5 at 10am PT or Fri 3/6 at 1pm PT — open to other slots.

Attachments: pricing-grid.xlsx (xlsx, stub); SOC2-summary.pdf (pdf, stub)

—Karthik
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophie Carter <sophie@greenlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Mar 2026 09:32:00 -0700
Subject: Checking in — GreenLytics timing for inference discovery

Hi Sophie — looping back on the note below. Wanted to check if the timeline / priority have shifted on your side for the Q2 evaluation. If procurement/security need anything else (longer SOC docs, DPA, or a data flow diagram) I can get that to you quickly.

If now isn’t the right time I can pause outreach — otherwise would love to lock a 30-min discovery to run through traffic shape and success criteria. Two immediate options I can offer:
- 15-min quick sync this week to confirm scope
- 30-min discovery with Tom next week to map to concrete latency/cost targets

Appreciate it — and happy to provide a short sandbox/demo credit if that helps with procurement.

Best,
Karthik

If you think this helps, can we tentatively book 30 mins next week? What does Tom's calendar look like? If you prefer, I can route a short DPA and SOC2 package to your security inbox right away.

Thanks for considering — we’d love to help GreenLytics move quickly if this is a priority for Q2.

—Marissa
